div.span: The only AWS WAF layer in this pattern: a web function endpoint takes no regional web ACL. With OAC as the lock, a request that skips the edge never reaches the code, so it cannot skip the web ACL either.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 38px; height: 1px; padding-top: 158px; margin-left: 1405px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FFFFFF;

display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.span: Supplies the WAF, rate limits, custom domain and warm origin connections the regional endpoint lacks. No Lambda@Edge origin triggers on this behavior.

div.span: Token pre-filter with 401 and resource_metadata, x-jwt-claims and x-forwarded-host for the origin.

div.span: The endpoint is public but takes IamAuth. CloudFront signs every origin request, and the function’s resource policy grants cloudfront.amazonaws.com lambda:InvokeWebFunctionEndpoint only for this distribution. Lambda refuses anything else before your code runs.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe center; width: 38px; height: 1px; padding-top: 434px; margin-left: 1405px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: center; color: #FFFFFF;
display: inline-block; font-size: 22px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #FFFFFF; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

display: inline-block; font-size: 14px; font-family: Helvetica; color: #000000; line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.span: Nothing in front of the function checks tokens, so the hello server verifies the RS256 signature and the mcp/web-function scope against the Cognito JWKS and serves the protected-resource metadata. Node.js from a zip; pay per use, nothing to run while idle.
